title: Strike Zone Fishing
specs: Coast Guard certified 43' Delta Sportfisher with twin engines
Boat booked at about half capacity for comfort and space
Professional fishing gear including Penn International Gold rods and reels and Pompanette fighting chair
$20 per day fee required by Department of Land and Natural Resources for each fisher over age 14 (active military and immediate family exempt)
Family-friendly and suitable for anglers of all experience levels
Boat capacity up to 16 bottom fishers and 6 riders for combo trips; up to 6 fishers and 6 riders for sport fishing trips
Private charters accommodate up to 16 bottom fishers and 6 riders

services.name: Charters We Run
services.desc: Private charters are a great way to enjoy the waters of Maui with the entire Strike Zone reserved just for your group. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion, hosting a company outing, or simply want the boat to yourselves, our friendly crew will help create a fun and memorable day on the water. Private charters can include a mix of bottom fishing and trolling depending on ocean conditions and your group’s preference. The Strike Zone can accommodate up to 16 bottom fishers (each with their own rod and reel) and 6 riders, making it a great option for families, celebrations, and groups looking for a more personalized fishing experience. All prices includes 20% gratuity, split directly

includes: Fishing gear included on all morning trips
Snacks, sodas, and water included on all morning trips
Snacks and beverages included on private charters
gap: Exact prices for trips not stated
blurb: Guests fish for big game and reef fish on a Coast Guard certified 43' Delta Sportfisher. Trips include high-speed trolling and bottom fishing along Maui’s southwest coast. The boat is booked at about half capacity for comfort and includes professional fishing gear and amenities.
extraNote: Department of Land and Natural Resources requires $20 per day fee per fisher over age 14 · Active military members and immediate family are exempt from the $20 fee · 300 Maalaea Road, Wailuku, on the ocean side of the harbor; paid parking behind the boat, 50¢ per hour; free parking behind Maui Ocean Center Aquarium and Maalaea Village shops.
